originalTitle: Leaks reveal a new Apple HomePod mini, iPad mini, and Apple TV 4K
summary: Apple is expected to announce more hardware before the end of the year following the debut of the iPhone 18 Pro and folding iPhone Duo earlier this month. The updated products will include a new version of the HomePod mini, the iPad mini 8, and the Apple TV 4K, according to details and images discovered […]
content: Apple is expected to announce more hardware before the end of the year following the debut of the iPhone 18 Pro and folding iPhone Duo earlier this month. The updated products will include a new version of the HomePod mini, the iPad mini 8, and the Apple TV 4K, according to details and images discovered in Apple’s own code by MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris. Details from the leaks are sparse, but the HomePod Mini 2 will carry forward a similar design to the original model that debuted in late 2020. While the current model is available in bright color options including orange, yellow, and blue, the leaked images of the HomePod Mini 2 reveal new green, pink, blue, white, and black shades that are more subdued and better suited to blending into existing decor. The new iPad mini 8 will replace the seventh-generation model that launched two years ago with an upgrade from Apple’s A17 Pro chip to the recently announced A20 Pro found in the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone Duo. The leaked images only show the front of the iPad mini 8, but Apple has moved its front-facing camera to the landscape edge of the tablet, while a groove on the top edge of the display, similar to the iPhone’s, seems to indicate an added speaker. As previously reported by Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, the next version of the iPad could also include improved waterproofing thanks to a new vibration-based speaker, and an OLED display like the larger iPad Pro features. The current version of the Apple TV is nearly four years old, but today’s leaks don’t give much away about what upgrades the new 4th generation version will include aside from a very similar design to its predecessor. Previous details uncovered by MacRumors’ Perris include a potential upgrade to Apple’s A17 Pro chip, while in 2024 Mark Gurman said the next Apple TV would use Apple’s in-house Bluetooth and Wi-Fi chip we now know as the N1.
chineseTitle: 泄密者透露了新的 Apple HomePod mini、iPad mini 和 Apple TV 4K
chineseSummary: 继本月早些时候推出 iPhone 18 Pro 和折叠 iPhone Duo 后，苹果预计将在年底前发布更多硬件。根据发现的细节和图像，更新的产品将包括新版本的 HomePod mini、iPad mini 8 和 Apple TV 4K […]
chineseContent: 继本月早些时候推出 iPhone 18 Pro 和折叠 iPhone Duo 后，苹果预计将在年底前发布更多硬件。 MacRumors 撰稿人 Aaron Perris 在苹果自己的代码中发现的详细信息和图像显示，更新的产品将包括新版 HomePod mini、iPad mini 8 和 Apple TV 4K。泄露的细节很少，但 HomePod Mini 2 将沿用与 2020 年底推出的原始型号类似的设计。虽然当前型号有橙色、黄色和蓝色等明亮的颜色可供选择，但 HomePod Mini 2 的泄露图像显示了新的绿色、粉色、蓝色、白色和黑色色调，这些色调更加柔和，更适合融入现有的装饰。新款 iPad mini 8 将取代两年前推出的第七代机型，从苹果的 A17 Pro 芯片升级到最近发布的 iPhone 18 Pro、Pro Max 和 iPhone Duo 中使用的 A20 Pro。泄露的图片仅显示了 iPad mini 8 的正面，但苹果已将前置摄像头移至平板电脑的横向边缘，而显示屏顶部边缘上的凹槽（与 iPhone 类似）似乎表明增加了扬声器。正如彭博社的 Mark Gurman 之前报道的那样，下一代 iPad 还可能包括改进的防水功能，这要归功于新的基于振动的扬声器，以及像更大的 iPad Pro 一样的 OLED 显示屏。当前版本的 Apple TV 已有近四年的历史，但今天的泄漏并没有透露太多关于新的第四代版本除了与其前身非常相似的设计外还将包括哪些升级。 MacRumors 的 Perris 之前披露的细节包括苹果 A17 Pro 芯片的潜在升级，而 Mark Gurman 则表示 2024 年可能会升级
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
